name: Posterior predictive check of B3 recovery and diagnosis of weight collapse on measured cells
reason: The natural probes (natural_probe_protocol.json) found B3 overestimating recovery after a 30-min pulse at 25 ng/ml (31% versus 4% of the naive rise), underestimating it after a 3-min pulse (8% versus 16%), and B3 weights collapsing on measured cells (effective sample size 1.0-1.4). A reviewer asked why. This descriptive study asks (1) whether the measured recoveries lie inside B3's own posterior predictive range at the doses B3 was and was not fitted to, and (2) what kind of deviation from B3 makes the weights collapse, including on the conditions B3 was fitted to.
exploration_disclosure: This protocol was written after an exploratory analysis of the same data and the same quantities (scripts outside the repository, 2026-10-08). The exploratory values are listed in known_before_freezing; the run below is the only one recorded, and its reading rules formalize statements whose outcome was already seen. The paper must say that the protocol was frozen after exploration.

data.conditions: measured blocks loaded as in expanded_fgf2 (complete cells only) and B3 simulated for the 1,000 posterior samples under each block's recorded command (b3_forecast.simulate_population), as in natural_probe
data.roles: 3/20 and sustained: training roles, used by the authors to fit B3 at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml; single 5-min pulse: validation role (naive reference); mixed at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml: inspected ('Viewed'), used by the authors only to compare architectures; mixed at 25 ng/ml: Test C; no B3 parameter was fitted at 25 ng/ml

definitions.rise: natural_probe.rise: maximum of the 3-frame moving average within (onset, onset + 20 min] minus the mean of the last two frames at or before the onset (B3: same on the noise-free trajectory, pre-onset default its start value)
definitions.mixed_ratio: mixed protocol, 5-min probe at 114 min (60 min after the end of the 30-min pulse): measured = median over cells of the probe rise divided by the median first rise of the single 5-min pulse cells at the same dose; B3 = per posterior sample, the probe rise divided by the same sample's single 5-min pulse rise
definitions.three_twenty_ratio: 3/20 protocol, second 3-min pulse at 23 min (20 min after the first pulse): measured = median over cells of the second rise divided by the same cell's first rise; B3 = per posterior sample, second rise divided by first rise
definitions.bootstrap: 2,000 cell resamples (numpy default_rng seed 20261012): mixed resamples probe cells and naive cells independently; 3/20 resamples cells (paired ratios); 95% percentile interval of the median ratio
definitions.posterior_predictive: 5%, 50% and 95% quantiles of the B3 ratio over the 1,000 samples and the share of samples at or below the measured median ratio
definitions.no_response_null: the measured ratio statistic on noise alone: 20,000 traces of independent normal noise (s.d. the condition's robust noise floor, nested_extensions.noise_floor) on the block's frames around a constant level, rise at the probe onset divided by the measured naive denominator (mixed: the naive median; 3/20: the median first rise); median and interquartile range (seed 20261013)
definitions.collapse_windows: frames up to and including the last frame at or before the decision time: mixed 114 min, 3/20 23 min, sustained 60 min; conditions mixed and 3/20 at the three doses, sustained at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml (fitted)
definitions.collapse_metrics: per measured cell against every posterior sample over the window: residual sum of squares raw (y - f_s), after a per-cell offset (y - f_s minus its mean) and after a per-cell affine map of the response (y - 1 = a + b (f_s - 1), least squares); best-sample residual RMS relative to the noise floor; effective sample size of the weights exp(-RSS / (2 sd^2)) with sd = max(noise floor, 0.005), as in natural_probe; lag-1 autocorrelation of the best raw residual; posterior reporter spread = median over window frames of the across-sample standard deviation; medians over cells

known_before_freezing: Exploratory values (same definitions, bootstrap seed 20261012): mixed ratio measured / B3 median / B3 5-95% / samples at or below measured: 2.5 ng/ml 0.361 [0.278, 0.442] / 0.423 / 0.355-0.481 / 0.065; 25 ng/ml 0.041 [0.022, 0.080] / 0.314 / 0.229-0.388 / 0.000; 250 ng/ml 0.078 [0.043, 0.137] / 0.347 / 0.269-0.403 / 0.000; no-response null median 0.040, 0.039, 0.046 (IQR up to 0.08). 3/20 ratio: 2.5 ng/ml 0.872 [0.768, 0.932] / 0.815 / 0.731-0.899; 25 ng/ml 0.159 [0.066, 0.249] / 0.081 / 0.049-0.122; 250 ng/ml 0.044 [0.026, 0.066] / 0.065 / 0.047-0.087. Collapse: posterior spread 0.0012-0.0041; best-sample residual 3.8-7.2 times the noise floor raw, 2.9-3.8 after an offset and 2.5-3.6 after an affine map; ESS 1.0-5.4; lag-1 autocorrelation 0.22-0.77 (0.75-0.77 for the mixed windows). An attempt to reproduce the measured deviation by spreading B3 parameters beyond the posterior (log-space inflation 1.5-2) left 23-47% of plants never ready within 120 min after the 30-min command and is not part of this protocol.

reading.R1: B3 is inconsistent with a measured recovery (protocol x dose) if the bootstrap 95% interval of the measured median ratio lies entirely outside the B3 5-95% posterior predictive range
reading.R2: the recovery error is localized to recovery after a long, strong command if R1 holds for the mixed probe at 25 and 250 ng/ml, does not hold for the mixed probe at 2.5 ng/ml, and does not hold for the 3/20 probe at the fitted doses 2.5 and 250 ng/ml
reading.R3: a measured recovery is indistinguishable from no response if its median ratio lies within the interquartile range of the no-response null
reading.R4: the weight collapse is attributed to cell-level deviations that the posterior does not represent if, in the fitted conditions (3/20 and sustained at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml), the median ESS is at most 3, the best-sample residual after the per-cell affine map exceeds twice the noise floor, and the posterior reporter spread is below the noise floor
reading.otherwise: the paper states the rule that failed

checks: verify_b3_recovery_check.py: (1) input hashes; (2) the 25 ng/ml mixed and 3/20 measured and B3 median ratios equal natural_probe_results.json (rise_over_naive of fgf_mixed_25ng/pulse_3 and fgf_3_20_25ng/pulse_2) within 1e-9 + 1e-5 |value|; (3) unit tests: affine residual zero for an exact affine copy, offset residual zero for a shifted copy, ESS equal to the number of samples for equal weights, rise of a known step; (4) a fresh recomputation equals the saved results within 1e-9 + 1e-5 |value|; (5) R1-R4 re-derived from the saved numbers with independent code.
reporting: All results reported whatever their direction; descriptive; cells of one condition share a session; the mixed naive reference comes from different cells; mixed 2.5 and 250 ng/ml are inspected data; the B3 ratio distribution expresses parameter uncertainty of a population-mean fit, not cell heterogeneity, so a measured median outside it shows that no posterior sample reproduces the measured population behaviour; nothing here re-fits B3.
